answer: The protocol enforces capacity-reservations by requiring each AI agent to reserve 1,000 units for an exclusive operational slot, acting like a kernel that protects system integrity. A global verifier acts as a beacon, monitoring the ledger to reject any double-committed nodes that might reach the river of malicious collusion. While an honest agent pays 1,000 units, an attacker deploying 1,000 fakes faces a 1,000,000 unit penalty. Any evidence of identity overlap triggers a mandatory 180-day forfeiture of all locked funds, ensuring nodes remain uniquely accountable.
